title: C++ Classes and Objects
description: Classes and objects: access specifiers, default and parameterised constructors, the destructor, this, member functions, static members, member initialiser lists and the copy constructor.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 類別與物件：存取修飾子、預設與帶參數的建構函式、解構函式、this、成員函式、靜態成員、成員初始設定清單以及複製建構函式。

questions.prompt: What is the default access level for the members of a class declared with the class keyword?

prompt.zh-Hant: 以 class 關鍵字宣告的類別，其成員預設的存取層級是甚麼？

explanation.zh-Hant: class 的成員與預設繼承都是 private；struct 則預設為 public。要讓外界使用必須明確標示 public。

options.text: It is chosen by the compiler.

questions.explanation: Members and default inheritance of a class are private, while a struct defaults to public. Members must be declared public to be used from outside the class.

questions.prompt: Inside a non-static member function of class Widget, what is the type of this?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在類別 Widget 的非靜態成員函式中，this 的型別是甚麼？

explanation.zh-Hant: this 是指向目前物件的指標，型別為 Widget*；在 const 成員函式中則為 const Widget*。

questions.explanation: this is a pointer to the object the member function was called on, so its type is Widget*. In a const member function it becomes const Widget*.

questions.prompt: A class has a member `const int id;`. Which constructor correctly initialises it?

prompt.zh-Hant: 某類別有成員 `const int id;`。哪一個建構函式能正確初始化它？

explanation.zh-Hant: const 成員必須在成員初始設定清單中初始化，語法是 `: id(i)`；在建構函式本體中賦值會編譯失敗，而 (d) 只是宣告了區域變數。

questions.explanation: A const member must be initialised in the member initialiser list, written `: id(i)`. Assigning in the constructor body is ill-formed because the member is already const, and option d only declares a local variable.

questions.prompt: Given `Widget a;` and `Widget b(5);`, which statement is true?

prompt.zh-Hant: 已知 `Widget a;` 與 `Widget b(5);`，下列哪一項敘述正確？

a.zh-Hant: a 使用預設建構函式，b 使用接受 int 的建構函式

b.zh-Hant: 兩者都使用預設建構函式

c.zh-Hant: a 使用接受 int 的建構函式，b 使用預設建構函式

d.zh-Hant: b 的宣告是無效的，物件一定要用大括號初始化

explanation.zh-Hant: 不帶引數的宣告呼叫預設建構函式，帶引數的宣告呼叫對應的建構函式；`Widget a;` 是預設初始化，`Widget b(5);` 是直接初始化。

options.text: a uses the default constructor and b uses the constructor that takes an int.
a uses the int constructor and b uses the default constructor.
The declaration of b is invalid; objects must use braces.

questions.explanation: A declaration without arguments calls the default constructor, and `b(5)` calls the constructor that accepts an int. `Widget a;` is default-initialisation; `Widget b(5);` is direct-initialisation.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are access specifiers in a C++ class? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是 C++ 類別中的存取修飾子？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: C++ 只有 public、private、protected 三種存取修飾子；friend 用來授權外部函式或類別存取私有成員，不是存取層級。

questions.explanation: C++ has exactly three access specifiers: public, private and protected. friend grants a named function or class access to private members, but it is not an access level.

questions.prompt: Which statements about static members are true? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列關於靜態成員的敘述，哪些是正確的？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 靜態資料成員由該類別的所有物件共用

b.zh-Hant: 靜態成員函式沒有 this 指標

c.zh-Hant: 靜態成員函式可以直接讀取非靜態資料成員

d.zh-Hant: C++17 起靜態資料成員可以在類別內以 inline 定義

explanation.zh-Hant: 靜態成員屬於類別而非個別物件，因此沒有 this，也不能直接存取非靜態成員；C++17 允許 inline static 在類別內定義。

options.text: A static data member is shared by all objects of the class.
A static member function has no this pointer.
A static member function can directly read non-static data members.
Since C++17 a static data member can be defined inline inside the class.

questions.explanation: Static members belong to the class rather than to an individual object, so they are shared and have no this pointer. A static member function cannot touch non-static members without an object, and C++17 allows `inline static` definitions inside the class.

questions.prompt: A copy constructor is called when an object of the class is passed to a function by value.

prompt.zh-Hant: 當類別的物件以值傳遞給函式時，會呼叫複製建構函式。

explanation.zh-Hant: 以值傳遞需要從原物件建立副本，因此會呼叫複製建構函式（編譯器可能省略，但語意上需要一個副本）。

questions.explanation: Passing by value requires a copy of the argument, so the copy constructor is used. The compiler may elide the copy in some cases, but the semantics still require an independent object.

questions.prompt: A destructor can be overloaded with different parameter lists, just like a constructor.

prompt.zh-Hant: 解構函式可以像建構函式一樣，用不同的參數列多載。

explanation.zh-Hant: 解構函式不接收參數，也不能多載；一個類別只能有一個解構函式，名稱是 ~類別名。

questions.explanation: A destructor takes no parameters and cannot be overloaded: a class has exactly one destructor, named ~ClassName.

questions.prompt: The special member function that runs automatically when an object goes out of scope is the ____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 當物件離開作用域時自動執行的特殊成員函式是 ____。

explanation.zh-Hant: 解構函式名稱是在類別名前加 ~，用來釋放物件持有的資源，例如記憶體或檔案句柄。

questions.explanation: The destructor is named with a leading ~ followed by the class name. It releases the resources the object owns, such as heap memory or file handles.

questions.prompt: In two or three sentences, explain the difference between initialising a member in the constructor's member initialiser list and assigning to it in the constructor body.

prompt.zh-Hant: 用兩至三句說明：在成員初始設定清單中初始化成員，與在建構函式本體中賦值，有甚麼分別。

model.zh-Hant: 成員初始設定清單會在建構函式本體執行前，直接用指定值建構成員，只發生一次初始化。若在本體中賦值，成員必須先被預設建構，再被覆寫，多了一次成本；而且 const 成員與參考成員無法用賦值的方式設定，只能寫在初始設定清單中。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵在於「初始化」與「賦值」是兩件事：初始設定清單直接建構，本體賦值則是先建構後覆寫。

answer.model: A member initialiser list constructs each member directly with the given value before the constructor body runs, so the member is initialised once. Assigning in the body instead requires the member to be default-constructed first and then overwritten, which costs an extra step. Members that are const or references cannot be assigned at all, so they can only be set in the initialiser list.

questions.explanation: Initialisation and assignment are different operations: the initialiser list constructs the member with its final value, while assigning in the body constructs a default value and then replaces it.
